name: dice-fortresses
description: Dice Fortresses — отдельный прототип (гибрид Dice Kingdoms × Forts). Папка: newgame Dice Fortresses.

scripts.demo: npm run proto -- --seed=6 --bot --replay=demo/replay.json && node -e "console.log('\nDemo finished. Try next: npm run challenge -- --help, npm run sim -- --help, or npm run web:dev for Save/Load.')"
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:proto && npm run smoke:challenge
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run web:build && npm run demo
scripts.release:bundle: npm run build && npm run web:build && node scripts/releaseBundle.mjs
